doc.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
doc.interviewee: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant

title: Opening of second reel and the Synigal home as Fiesta headquarters
summary: Recording is set up on 17 May 1962 at the Synigal home; the women are introduced and Mrs. Synigal describes the house as fiesta headquarters with a patio meeting room.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We're recording today, May the 17th, 1962 at 1938 Laperoo Street. Could we get your names down here? You want my name? Your full name. Mrs. Edna. Thank you.
Let's see, this is a second reel and we're interviewing Madame Senegal and Madame Bozon. Am I getting it right?

That's right. Mr. Senegal and Miss Sandra have just stepped out for a minute. Let's see, better put today's date on here so we don't get it mixed up. May the 17th, 1962. Yes. By the way, this is your home here, isn't it? This is my home. We're calling it.
And by the way, it's the headquarters for the pre-old fiesta. This is headquarters.
See, in the weekly, they give us a dress.

That's right, headquarters. And we have a meeting room in patio. Next time you come, I'll bring you in the patio, babe. You can take notes of the patio, how nice it is. And then the meeting room, that's where we meet. I'll just let a few come in. And we have board meetings, you know, here. But our meeting room is really nice out there. We'll enjoy it. Now we are, what do you want to talk about, the fiesta? If he asked you.
